gates.name: judge_hook

gates.name: judge_facts
gates.detail: factual risk 2/10: A $15 per month subscription for 10 years adds up to $1,800 out of your pocket (basic math is correct: $15 * 120 = $1800, but framing a tiny amount as thousands is slightly exaggerated); A $5 a day habit equals $1,825 a year (math is correct, but abruptly pivots from $15/month to $5/day without clear context); If you invest that same amount monthly at 8% for 30 years, it turns into $226,659 (math applies to $15/month invested, but the transition from the $5/day habit makes the referent ambiguous)
